stories.key_takeaway: Frontier agents can build a covert channel from one-bit success feedback alone, so a monitor that checks one message at a time cannot protect secrets between agents that learn from repeated interactions.

pull_quote.text: Screening what a message says therefore cannot by itself protect a secret between agents who learn from each other.

stories.headline: California Requires Ads to Disclose AI-Generated Performers Under SB 1050
stories.key_takeaway: California is now the second state after New York to require labels on ads that prominently feature AI-generated performers, and because private plaintiffs can sue under its false-advertising and unfair-competition laws, advertiser risk is higher than in New York.

pull_quote.text: Californians deserve to know when the person selling them something isn't a person at all.

stories.article_excerpt: Starting January 1, 2027, if the smiling spokesperson in a California ad was generated by AI, the ad has to say so.
